faqs.q: What are Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Aluminium fins extruded out of a thick aluminium sleeve over a steel, stainless or copper-alloy liner tube. The sleeve covers the liner completely and leaves no crevice at the fin root, so extruded fins are the usual choice for air coolers in coastal, offshore and humid Gulf plants. It is listed in 2 sizes, 25.4 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: What sizes do Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes are listed in 2 sizes, 25.4 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-EX-ALU-0254 and IH-TF-EX-ALU-0254-B. The table includes 25.4 mm OD by 2.11 (14 BWG) mm wall and 25.4 mm OD by 2.11 (14 BWG) mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity, with the fin type, material. Height, thickness and fins per inch, and the bare length at each end. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What is the maximum service temperature of Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: The maximum service temperature for Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes: 285 °C typical maker limit (published 280–315 °C). Where a figure is not listed for a size, we confirm it on the quotation.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: For Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes, testing follows the governing standard: Fin bond: HTRI found bond resistance is not negligible even on new tubes; Liner tube hydrostatic/NDT per its base spec (A179/A334). Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes are available in these grades: Carbon steel SA179, SA334 Gr 6; Stainless, duplex, titanium, copper alloys (liner of almost any material). The fin or coating material is Aluminium 1100; Aluminium 1050/1060.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes are made to API 661 / ISO 13706, ASTM A179 / ASME SA179, SA334 Gr 6, ASME SA210. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes, finned tubes are fitted in header boxes and carried at the tube supports, usually with support collars, so the fin outside diameter has to match the supports and headers. Related ranges are the [HF-Welded Spiral Fin Tubes](/c/hf-welded-spiral-fin-tubes) and [Embedded G-Fin Tubes](/c/embedded-g-fin-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: Where are Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes used?
faqs.a: Extruded Aluminium Fin Tubes are used for: Air-cooled heat exchangers in gas processing, LNG (MR and propane coolers), gas compression stations and refineries; Coastal and offshore air coolers, where extruded fins are preferred for atmospheric corrosion.
